patterns.name: Base-anchored variety
patterns.description: Return to base 0 every stroke while reach gradually varies between short and broad. Pace stays independent.

patterns.name: Base-anchored drift
patterns.description: Return to base 0 while reach wanders gradually and irregularly. Longer variation memory; pace stays independent.

patterns.name: Breathing window
patterns.description: Gradually move a varying-width window through the band. Width wanders between 20 and 65; neither endpoint stays anchored.

patterns.name: Centered drift
patterns.description: Keep the middle fixed while stroke width wanders gradually and irregularly. Both endpoints move symmetrically.

patterns.name: Centered variety
patterns.description: Gradually vary stroke width symmetrically around the middle. Both endpoints move; neither endpoint is anchored.

patterns.name: Even-beat variety
patterns.description: Vary width irregularly around the middle while holding a steadier cycle beat. Short strokes travel more slowly.

patterns.name: Full sweeps
patterns.description: Repeat smooth full-length strokes from base 0 to tip 100. Fixed reach and even pace.

patterns.name: Lower strokes
patterns.description: Repeat smooth fixed-width strokes only in the lower/base region, 0–40. Even pace.

patterns.name: Middle strokes
patterns.description: Repeat smooth fixed-width strokes only around the middle, 30–70. Even pace.

patterns.name: Pace wave
patterns.description: Keep every stroke full-length while pace gradually slows and rises over eight cycles. Reach does not change.

patterns.name: Soft turnarounds
patterns.description: Keep full-length strokes and even pace with longer, gentler turnarounds at both ends. Reach does not vary.

patterns.name: Tip-anchored variety
patterns.description: Return to tip 100 every stroke while reach gradually varies between short and broad. Pace stays independent.

patterns.name: Tip-anchored drift
patterns.description: Return to tip 100 while reach wanders gradually and irregularly. Longer variation memory; pace stays independent.

patterns.name: Traveling window
patterns.description: Keep a 40-wide stroke window and gradually move it from lower to middle to upper and back. Preserve stroke width.

patterns.name: Upper strokes
patterns.description: Repeat smooth fixed-width strokes only in the upper/tip region, 60–100. Even pace.

patterns.name: Wide then narrow
patterns.description: Repeat four full-width cycles, then four middle-width cycles. Blend between the two sections; keep the pace setting.

patterns.name: Three-zone tour
patterns.description: Repeat four lower cycles, four middle, four upper, then four middle. Blend each transition; retain short strokes.

patterns.name: Notched Full Sweep
patterns.description: Mostly full-span reversals with one shortened peak. Reversal timing varies within the loop.

patterns.name: Full Sweep Run A
patterns.description: Repeating full-span reversals. Reversal timing is even.

patterns.name: Full Sweep Run B
patterns.description: Repeating full-span reversals. Reversal timing is even.

patterns.description: Repeating full-span reversals. Reversal timing is even.

patterns.name: Peak Steps

patterns.name: Upper Cascade
patterns.description: An upper-biased sequence moves through several return depths and peaks. Grouped timing creates offbeat accents.

patterns.name: Return Depth Shuffle
patterns.description: Broad strokes shuffle among full and partial return depths. Reversal timing varies within the loop.

patterns.name: Broken Full Sweep
patterns.description: Full-span reversals are interrupted by a small set of partial returns. Reversal timing is even.

patterns.name: Peak Ladder Mosaic

patterns.name: Midrange Break

patterns.name: Descending Peak Finish

patterns.name: Multi-Level Circuit A

patterns.name: Upper Shelf Pulse

patterns.name: Return Ladder

patterns.name: Multi-Level Circuit B

patterns.name: Return Depth Accents

patterns.name: Peak Drift

patterns.name: Lowered Return Shuffle

patterns.name: Full Sweep Tail

patterns.name: Upper Step Blocks

patterns.name: Offset Zigzag

patterns.name: Multi-Level Drift

patterns.name: Sine
patterns.description: Smooth sinusoidal wave motion. Gentle, continuous up and down movement ideal for slow teasing or sustained stimulation.

patterns.name: Fast Stroke
patterns.description: Quick full-range strokes. Rapid up and down movement for intense stimulation at high speeds.

patterns.name: Slow Tease
patterns.description: Slow, deliberate strokes with pauses. Builds anticipation with extended holds at extremes.

patterns.name: Pulse
patterns.description: Rhythmic pulsing motion in mid-range. Quick pulses centered around 50% position.

patterns.name: Edge Hold
patterns.description: Long slow strokes to the edge with extended holds. Builds to near-climax then backs off.

patterns.name: Grind
patterns.description: Short, grinding movements at the top. Small range motion focused on the upper region.

patterns.name: Depth Thrust
patterns.description: Full depth thrusting motion. Deep strokes from top to bottom with consistent rhythm.

patterns.name: Random Tease
patterns.description: Varied positions with irregular timing. Unpredictable movements that keep stimulation interesting.

patterns.name: Wave Build
patterns.description: Gradual intensity building wave. Starts slow and increases in speed before resetting.

patterns.name: Shallow Fast
patterns.description: Fast shallow strokes. Quick movements in the lower third for focused stimulation.

patterns.name: Wave
patterns.description: Smooth, even sinusoidal reciprocating motion.

patterns.name: Realistic
patterns.description: Asymmetric slider-crank motion with different acceleration in each direction.

patterns.name: Thrust
patterns.description: Slow retract, rapid thrust and brief hold.

patterns.name: Escalate
patterns.description: Sine movement that gradually builds its stroke depth.

patterns.name: Consistent Rhythm
patterns.description: Steady full-range rhythm with even timing.

patterns.name: Build Over Time
patterns.description: Progressively accelerates from slow strokes to fast strokes.

patterns.name: Random Phases
patterns.description: Deterministic varied phases with changing depth and timing.

patterns.name: Swing 3-2
patterns.description: Asymmetric 3-2 rhythm with alternating depth.

patterns.name: Long-Short Pulse
patterns.description: Two long strokes followed by a short accent and recovery.

patterns.name: Syncopated Wave
patterns.description: Irregular flowing rhythm with off-beat depth changes.

patterns.name: Double Accent
patterns.description: Two quick accents separated by a longer relaxed section.

patterns.name: Broken Triplet
patterns.description: Broken three-part rhythm with changing reach.

patterns.name: Rolling Six
patterns.description: Rolling six-accent sequence with changing peaks.

patterns.name: Wave (Edgy)
patterns.description: Gradually rises and falls in intensity while stroke reach varies.

patterns.name: Pulse (Edgy)
patterns.description: Six short high-intensity bursts separated by longer rests.

patterns.name: Escalation (Edgy)
patterns.description: Smooth motion that steadily builds speed and reach over the loop.

patterns.name: Tease (Edgy)
patterns.description: Small slow movements interrupted by sudden large strokes.

patterns.name: Chaos (Edgy)
patterns.description: Rapidly changing depth and timing in an unpredictable deterministic loop.

patterns.name: The Teasing Ghost
patterns.description: Extremely slow full-range rise and return.

patterns.name: The Inchworm
patterns.description: Tiny strokes crawl gradually across the entire available range and back.

patterns.name: The Fake-Out Exit
patterns.description: Gradually slows, pauses, then returns with three fast full-range accents.

patterns.name: Gentle (FunSync)
patterns.description: Smooth sine motion at roughly 30 BPM and 80% depth.

patterns.name: Steady (FunSync)
patterns.description: Even full-depth triangle motion at roughly 40 BPM.

patterns.name: Building (FunSync)
patterns.description: Escalating reach at roughly 35 BPM.

patterns.name: Drift (FunSync)
patterns.description: Slow randomized drift around the middle of the range.

patterns.name: Pulse (FunSync)
patterns.description: Pulse-style holds with short ramps between low and high positions.
